---
title: "viewership"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(googlesheets4)
```

```{r}
sheet_url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WMA57xEdIjt6KxCQLeTaZe_CIYXcyOW0NnqKxB2ORhE/edit?usp=sharing"

gs4_deauth()

viewership <- read_sheet(sheet_url)

if ("Viewership" %in% names(viewership) && is.character(viewership$Viewership)) {
viewership$Viewership <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", viewership$Viewership))
}
```

```{r}
team_viewership <- viewership |> 
  group_by(Teams)  |> 
  summarize(Total_Viewership = sum(Viewership, na.rm = TRUE))  |> 
  arrange(desc(Total_Viewership))

team_viewership |>
  filter(Total_Viewership > 18409000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Teams, Total_Viewership), y = Total_Viewership)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Total Viewership by Team",
       x = "Teams",
       y = "Total Viewership") +
  theme_minimal()

conference_viewership <- viewership |> 
  group_by(Conference)  |> 
  summarize(Total_Viewership = sum(Viewership, na.rm = TRUE))  |> 
  arrange(desc(Total_Viewership))
  
conference_viewership |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Conference, Total_Viewership), y = Total_Viewership)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "darkorange") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Total Viewership by Conference",
       x = "Conference",
       y = "Total Viewership") +
  theme_minimal()

network_viewership <- viewership |> 
  group_by(Channel)  |> 
  summarize(Total_Viewership = sum(Viewership, na.rm = TRUE))  |> 
  arrange(desc(Total_Viewership))

network_viewership |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Channel, Total_Viewership), y = Total_Viewership)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "forestgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Total Viewership by Network",
       x = "Network",
       y = "Total Viewership") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Convert to wide format
view_wide <- viewership  |> 
  # Select relevant columns
  select(Week, Teams, Viewership)  |> 
  # Pivot wider so weeks become columns
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Week,
    values_from = Viewership,
    names_prefix = ""  # You can add a prefix like "Week_" if desired
  ) 

week_cols <- grep("^Week", names(view_wide), value = TRUE)
week_cols_sorted <- week_cols[order(as.numeric(gsub("Week ", "", week_cols)))]

view_wide <- view_wide %>%
  select(Teams, all_of(week_cols_sorted)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Viewership = sum(c_across(starts_with("Week")), na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_Per_Week = mean(c_across(starts_with("Week")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Viewership))


write.csv(view_wide, "view_wide.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
